title: Fourier Weight of an Upper-Tail Indicator
statement: For every real threshold $t$ and every natural number $m$, let $A$ be the indicator on the $(m+1)$-dimensional Boolean cube of the event that the normalized sum of its coordinates exceeds $t$. Its level-one Fourier weight equals the square of the uniform mean of the product of $A$ with that normalized sum.
